name: pi-code
description: Manage Pi Agent inside Visual Studio Code
author: dannycreations

virtualWorkspaces.description: Pi Code runs shell commands and reads project files from disk.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Project-local agent resources and command execution stay disabled until the workspace is trusted.

pi-code.enableTodoTool.markdownDescription: Let the agent break work into a checklist and keep it updated while it works (`update_todo`).

pi-code.enableAskQuestionTool.markdownDescription: Let the agent pause and ask you for details when a request is unclear (`ask_question`).

pi-code.enableSubagentTool.markdownDescription: Let the agent delegate read-only research to a sub-agent that works in its own context window and reports back a summary (`spawn_subagent`).

pi-code.enableAgentRules.markdownDescription: Let the agent auto load `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` files for project-specific instructions.

pi-code.enableSkillDiscovery.markdownDescription: Let the agent pick skills (`SKILL.md` files) on its own. When off, skills stay available and you load one explicitly with `/skill:<name>`.

pi-code.yolo.description: Automatically approve every agent tool call without asking. Overrides the per-action approval settings below.

pi-code.yoloRespectDenied.description: In yolo mode, still block tool calls that match your denied paths and commands.

pi-code.autoApproveRead.markdownDescription: Automatically allow the agent to read files and line ranges (`read_file`).

pi-code.autoApproveSkillReads.markdownDescription: Automatically allow the agent to read skill files (`SKILL.md`) when it uses a skill. Requires read auto approval.

pi-code.autoApproveWrite.markdownDescription: Automatically allow the agent to create and edit files (`write_file`, `edit_file`).

pi-code.autoApproveDelete.markdownDescription: Automatically allow the agent to delete files (`delete_file`). Use with caution.

pi-code.autoApproveExecute.markdownDescription: Automatically allow the agent to run terminal commands (`execute_command`) inside your terminal shell environment.

pi-code.allowedReadPaths.description: Files matching these globs are auto-approved for reading. Add * to allow all paths.

pi-code.deniedReadPaths.description: Files matching these globs are blocked from reading, overriding allowed paths.

pi-code.allowedWritePaths.description: Files matching these globs are auto-approved for writing and editing. Add * to allow all paths.

pi-code.deniedWritePaths.description: Files matching these globs are blocked from writing and editing, overriding allowed paths.

pi-code.allowedDeletePaths.description: Files matching these globs are auto-approved for deleting. Add * to allow all paths.

pi-code.deniedDeletePaths.description: Files matching these globs are blocked from deleting, overriding allowed paths.

pi-code.allowedExecuteCommands.description: Commands starting with these prefixes are auto-approved. Add * to allow all commands.

pi-code.deniedExecuteCommands.description: Commands starting with these prefixes are blocked, overriding allowed commands.

pi-code.autoCompactContext.description: Automatically compact conversation context when it reaches the threshold.

pi-code.autoCompactContextPercent.description: The percentage of the context window in use before auto compaction runs.

pi-code.maxOpenTabsContext.description: Maximum number of open editor tabs to include in context. Higher values provide more context but increase token usage.

pi-code.maxWorkspaceFiles.description: Maximum number of workspace files to include in context. Higher values provide more context but increase token usage.

pi-code.excludeIgnoredFiles.description: Hide files and folders matched by .gitignore when listing workspace files. Reduces context noise from build output and dependencies.

pi-code.maxGitStatusFiles.description: Maximum number of changed files to include in git status context. Set to 0 to disable. Branch info is always shown when above 0.

pi-code.maxConcurrentFileReads.markdownDescription: Maximum number of files the `read_file` tool loads in parallel. Higher values may speed up reading many small files but increase memory usage.

pi-code.maxToolOutputLines.description: Maximum number of lines a single tool result may send to the model. Whichever limit is reached first, lines or size, triggers truncation.

pi-code.maxToolOutputSizeKb.description: Maximum size a single tool result may send to the model. Truncated results keep a notice explaining how to retrieve the remaining output.
